project.name: litecodeagent
lessons: `gh api graphql -f name=value` sends every variable as a STRING, so list variables are rejected outright. That once shipped a GraphQL command that could never succeed, through every release up to 0.9.0, because no test looked at the request body. Post variables as a JSON body on stdin, and assert on what goes over the wire — pure-function tests cannot catch an encoding bug.

angles.name: correctness
angles.covers: Does the change actually solve the stated problem, and what edge cases does it miss.
angles.triggeredBy: always — every non-trivial change gets this angle

angles.name: contract
angles.covers: Breaking changes for consumers of a public endpoint or an exported type.
angles.triggeredBy: the change touches an endpoint signature, a response shape, or an exported type

angles.name: operability
angles.covers: Logging, error handling and observability — how failures get diagnosed in production.
angles.triggeredBy: the change affects error paths, logging, or external-call failure handling

domains.match: auth, user input validation, or an external integration
